sloka: यच्चैतच्चरितं दिव्यं कथा ते रघुनन्दन ।तन्मयाप्सरसो नाम श्रावयेयुर्नरर्षभ ।। ७.४०.१७ ॥
transliteration: yaccaitaccaritaṁ divyaṁ kathā te raghunandana ।tanmayāpsaraso nāma śrāvayeyurnararṣabha ।। 7.40.17 ॥

translations.english: O Rama, delight of the Raghus and best among men, may the Apsaras indeed make me hear this divine story and your divine deeds.
